subject: DNA helix
full_caption:
Most people can't make this DNA switch direction. Can you?

It's made only of dots with no depth cues, so your brain has to guess which side is in front. Blink, look at the edge, and try to flip it.

Did you manage to switch it? How long did it take? 👇
Follow @opticpop for a new illusion every day ✨
